title: 14 sajda-surahs FR cohesion test
interpretation: 14 sajda-surahs are NOT FR-content-cohesive (within-cluster mean is slightly ABOVE corpus baseline). The classical sujūd-al-tilāwah classification is functional-liturgical (where to prostrate during recitation), NOT a content-fingerprint classification. This adds the sajda-classification to the project's catalog of functional-classifications-without-content-cohesion (alongside H-NEW-68 Friday-recitation NULL, H-NEW-69 14-vs-14 alphabet-split NULL).
